record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce only the tied normalized item-embedding radius multiplier from 0.8 to 0.75, retaining width 64 and input/output tying. The regression at 0.9 motivates testing a smaller local reduction that may regularize item representations without the larger change to 0.65. Preserve features, topology, interaction/scoring, history, loss temperature and optimizer. Apply the same radius in training and the generated predictor, with one checkpoint per category.
